description: See what every running agent is doing, and which one needs you, from a live wall at the foot of the sidebar. Each tile shows the tool call in flight, the files touched in the last minute, a 60-second activity trace, and how much of its context window the thread has used. Threads blocked on a question or an approval are marked and sorted to the top. Pop the wall out as a monitor you can drag anywhere in BB. The bb agent-tv status command gives terminals and agents the same feed, and nothing leaves your BB server.
